tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of safety shoes
tenderSchedule.locationName: BESCOM Corporate Office Procurement section Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: O/o Chief General Manager (Ele.), Procurement, 2nd Floor, 2nd Block, Corporate office, BESCOM, K. R Circle

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per the tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have supplied at least 80% (40% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) of the tendered quantity of safety shoes in any one of the preceding 3 years i.e., 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 (last 2 years i.e., 2024-25 & 2025-26 for Micro & Small Enterprises) to Electricity Distribution companies or Government Electrical Utilities/PSUs.Documents to be uploaded:Scanned copies of Order completion certificates issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent of the concerned Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities/PSUs shall be uploaded.Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload performance certificate for having satisfactory operation of 80% of the tendered quantity (However it will be 40% to Micro and Small Enterprises) of safety shoes supplied to any Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities/PSUs and in satisfactory operation for at least one year as on the date of bid submission in any one of the last 3 preceding years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (last 2 years i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises).Documents to be uploaded:Scanned copies of Performance Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent officer of the Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities/PSUs shall be uploaded.Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that Bidder is a Micro and Small Enterprises.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not be under default/ debarred/ blacklisted by any Electricity Distribution Companies or Govt. Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the date of bid submission. Documents to be uploaded: Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Litigation History: The Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years, a consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any partner may result in rejection of Bid. Documents to be uploaded: Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following: a) Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto b) LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c) Partnership Firm under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d)Sole Proprietorship Concern. Documents to be uploaded: a) i. Certificate of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association of the Company. ii. Declaration from Directors of the Company in MBP-1 Form stating that they are not disqualified to be a Director of the Company along with the list of Companies in which they are Directors as on the date of inviting tender(s). b) i. Certification of Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per LLP Act 2008. ii. Limited Liability Partnership Agreement of LLP. c)i. Partnership Deed, GST Registration certificate. ii. Shops & Establishment Registration certificate, as applicable. d)PAN/GST Registration certificate.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall be a Manufacturer / Authorized Dealer / Distributor of safety shoes. Documents to be uploaded:1.In case the Bidder is a Manufacturer, valid documentary proof such as license issued by Commerce & Industries department or any other Government Statutory Authority shall be uploaded.2.In case of Authorized Dealer/Distributor:a.Manufacturing license of Original Equipment Manufacturer from whom the Dealer/Distributor gets the material.b.Valid authorization letter from the OEM assuring full guarantee/warranty as per the tender conditions.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall submit two samples of tendered material, confirming to the tender specifications to the office of the tendered inviting authority within the due date and time notified for submission of bid.Documents to be uploaded:Scanned copy of the self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- by the Bidder adhering to this clause shall be uploaded.The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority. (As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dated 25.08.2020.) Documents to be uploaded: Scanned copy of Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded regarding Boarder sharing or not. If the Bidder is from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format: I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfils all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. (Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached.) Documents to be uploaded: Scanned copy of the self-declaration in the prescribed format as per Annexure-II on notarized stamp paper of Rs.500/- shall be uploaded. The self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have valid Bureau of Indian Standard Certification.Documents to be uploaded: Valid BIS certificates shall be uploaded.Note: In case of authorized dealer/distributor, BIS certificate of OEM shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload the type test certificates for having conducted all the type tests mentioned in the relevant IS/technical specification on tendered type safety equipment at CPRI/ ERDA/Government laboratories /Government Testing Houses & such type test reports shall not be older than five years as on the last date of bid submission. Document to be uploaded:Valid type test certificates from CPRI/ERDA/Government laboratories /Government Testing Houses shall be uploaded.Note: In case of Authorized Dealer/Distributor, type test certificates of OEM shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Average Annual Financial Turnover of the Bidder shall not be less than the Amount Put to Tender (However it will be 50% in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises) during the preceding 3 financial years i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (However, it will be last 2 years i.e., 2023-24 and 2024-25 for Micro & Small Enterprises). Documents to be uploaded: Certified copies of audited financial statements such as P&L statement, Balance sheets for the required FYs shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid Assets as on 30.09.2026 or at a later date before submission of the bid consisting of Cash at Bank (plus) Term Deposits (plus) availability of fund based credit facilities in any Nationalized/scheduled Bank shall not be less than 25% of the amount put to tender. Documents to be uploaded: The cash at Bank, Bank Deposits and availability of fund based credit facilities shall be supported by a certificate issued by Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank shall be uploaded. If the Bidder has banking with more than one Bank, then the available balance liquid assets mentioned above on a particular date i.e., 30.09.2026 or any date before submission of tender shall be the same date and time for all the banks. In case of Fund Based credit facility, the certificate issued by Nationalized/ Scheduled Bank duly mentioning sanctioned limits, funds utilized so far and balance available as on 30.09.2026 or at a later date, before submission of the bid shall be uploaded. The certificate shall be submitted in the format as per Annexure-II

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant document to be uploaded.
